name: Bloom Energy Corporation

sections.title: Quarterly revenue
sections.callout: Outlook: Bloom expects 2026 revenue of $3.1B–$3.3B, up about 58% at the midpoint.

footnotes: Operating income was positive, but $157M of interest, debt-conversion and extinguishment costs (net of $2M other income) produced an $84M pre-tax loss; the chart shows operating income absorbed by those costs.
Free cash flow = operating cash flow − purchases of property, plant & equipment (calculated). Total debt = recourse + non-recourse debt, excluding $244M of financing obligations.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Bloom Energy's revenue grew 37.3% to a record $2.0B in 2025, led by fuel-cell product sales to power data centers, up 41.1%. Gross margin rose to 29.0%, and operating income more than tripled to $73M.
Charges from refinancing convertible notes, plus interest, turned that into an $88M net loss. Bloom raised capital, lifting cash to $2.5B, and its product backlog grew about 2.5 times to roughly $6B.
highlights: Q4 2025 revenue reached a record $778M, up 35.9%.
Product backlog grew about 2.5 times to roughly $6B.
watch: Debt-conversion and extinguishment charges of $99M drove a net loss.
Gross margin of 29% is thin for a hardware business.
sources: Bloom Energy Q4 and full-year 2025 results (SEC 8-K)
